entity_raw.definition_raw:
You have an extra wellspring of kundalini energy that you can use to open your chakras.

Prerequisite(s): Ability to awaken the root chakra.

Benefit(s): You gain a pool that holds 3 points of serpentfire ki, which you can use only to open or maintain chakras.

These serpent-fire ki points are replenished at the same time you replenish the points in your regular ki pool.
